# Adding Families and Components to Metadata

## #1 Load Packages

```{r}
library(here)
library(stringr)
```

## #2 Import Data

```{r}
metadata = read.csv(here("results","table_Zenodo_full.csv"))

ifc = read.csv(here("protocol","interventions_families_components.csv"),
               na.strings = "")
```

## #3 Add Family and Component Columns

```{r}
column_family = ifc$Family[match(metadata$Intervention, ifc$Intervention)]
column_component1 = ifc$Component1[match(metadata$Intervention, ifc$Intervention)]
column_component2 = ifc$Component2[match(metadata$Intervention, ifc$Intervention)]

column_family = ifc$Family[match(metadata$Intervention, ifc$Intervention)]

table = cbind(metadata[,1:11],
              column_family,
              column_component1,
              column_component2,
              metadata[,12:ncol(metadata)])

table = as.data.frame(table)
```

## #4 Export File

```{r}
write.csv(table,
          here("results", "table_Zenodo_complete.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
```
